title: Cell Killing Assay Protocol for Recombinant DT3C Protein Complexed with Anti-CCR8 Antibody
author: Rosie Liu

steps.title: Prepare complete culture medium
steps.instruction: Combine RPMI 1640 with 10 % fetal bovine serum and 10 µg/mL puromycin, filter‑sterilize through a 0.22 µm filter, store at 4 °C for up to 1 month, and pre‑warm to 37 °C before use.

steps.title: Prepare serum‑free medium
steps.instruction: Use plain RPMI 1640 without FBS or puromycin and pre‑warm to 37 °C before use.

steps.title: Thaw and aliquot anti‑CCR8 antibody
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the antibody vial at 12 000 rpm for 30 s, aliquot into single‑use volumes, store at –20 °C to –80 °C, equilibrate to room temperature for 15 min before use and mix gently by pipetting.

steps.title: Reconstitute DT3C protein
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the DT3C vial at 12 000 rpm for 30 s, add 20 µL sterile deionized water to obtain 1 mg/mL, add 20 µL sterile glycerol to reach a final glycerol concentration of 50 %, aliquot 5 µL portions, store at –20 °C to –80 °C, and avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Prepare CCK‑8 solution
steps.instruction: Thaw CCK‑8 reagent at room temperature protected from light; immediately before use dispense 10 µL per well.

steps.title: Make antibody dilution series
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 µg/mL anti‑CCR8 stock in serum‑free medium and perform eight 2‑fold serial dilutions to obtain concentrations of 20, 10, 5, 2.5, 1.25, 0.625, 0.3125, and 0.156 µg/mL (final antibody concentrations after mixing will be 0.078‑10 µg/mL).

steps.title: Prepare DT3C working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the reconstituted DT3C protein in pre‑warmed serum‑free medium to a final concentration of 20 µg/mL (2× working solution), which will be mixed 1:1 with antibody dilutions to give a final DT3C concentration of 10 µg/mL.

steps.title: Thaw and expand cell line
steps.instruction: Rapidly thaw CT26/Human CCR8 stable cells (CSB‑SC004847HU3) in a 37 °C water bath with gentle agitation, transfer to a 15 mL tube containing 9 mL pre‑warmed complete medium, centrifuge at 1000 rpm for 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 10 mL complete medium, seed into a T75 flask, incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified; passage every 2‑3 days at 80‑90 % confluence using 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA, and use cells < passage 15 in logarithmic growth phase for the assay.

steps.title: Seed cells in 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Aspirate medium from the T75 flask, wash twice with 5 mL sterile PBS, add 2 mL 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 37 °C for 2‑3 min until cells detach, add 8 mL complete medium to neutralize, transfer to a 15 mL tube and centrifuge at 1000 rpm for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in complete medium, count cells and adjust to 5 × 10⁴ cells/mL, dispense 100 µL (5 × 10³ cells) into each well of a 96‑well plate, and incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Form DT3C‑antibody complexes
steps.instruction: In a separate 96‑well plate, mix 50 µL 2× DT3C working solution (20 µg/mL) with 50 µL of each antibody dilution (20, 10, 5, 2.5, 1.25, 0.625, 0.3125, 0.156 µg/mL) to obtain 100 µL complexes; set up triplicate controls: blank (100 µL serum‑free RPMI, no cells), cell control (100 µL serum‑free RPMI with cells), DT3C alone (100 µL 10 µg/mL DT3C in serum‑free medium), antibody alone (100 µL 10 µg/mL CCR8 antibody in serum‑free medium); gently mix and incubate 30 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Add complexes to cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of each DT3C‑antibody complex or control solution to the corresponding wells of the cell‑seeded plate (three replicates per condition) and incubate 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Post‑incubation wash and culture
steps.instruction: Aspirate the medium containing unbound complexes, wash each well twice with 200 µL pre‑warmed serum‑free RPMI leaving approximately 20 µL residual volume, add 200 µL pre‑warmed complete culture medium, and incubate for 48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Detect cell viability with CCK‑8
steps.instruction: Aspirate 100 µL supernatant from each well leaving 100 µL medium, add 10 µL CCK‑8 reagent, tap the plate gently to mix without creating bubbles, and incubate 4 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in the dark.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a microplate reader and measure absorbance at 450 nm (use 630 nm as reference if available); record all values for analysis.

steps.title: Normalize data and calculate viability
steps.instruction: Calculate the average absorbance for each set of triplicate wells, then compute cell viability % = [(OD₄₅₀ experimental – OD₄₅₀ blank) / (OD₄₅₀ cell control – OD₄₅₀ blank)] × 100 %; determine the mean and standard deviation for each group.

steps.title: Generate dose‑response curve
steps.instruction: Plot the logarithm of the anti‑CCR8 antibody concentration (µg/mL) on the x‑axis versus the corresponding cell viability % on the y‑axis, fit the data with a four‑parameter logistic (4PL) regression to obtain a sigmoidal curve showing decreasing viability with increasing antibody concentration for the DT3C + antibody group.

steps.title: Calculate ED₅₀
steps.instruction: From the fitted 4PL curve, determine the antibody concentration that yields 50 % cell death in the presence of 10 µg/mL DT3C; the expected ED₅₀ range is 0.4661‑0.8614 µg/mL.

steps.title: Interpret results
steps.instruction: Confirm a dose‑dependent decrease in viability for the DT3C + antibody group, no significant cytotoxicity (>90 % viability) for antibody‑only and DT3C‑only controls, and an ED₅₀ within the expected range, indicating a valid assay and biologically active DT3C protein.
